reviewItem.question: For "Go module path is now `github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2`: As this release is a major version bump that has breaking changes, the rules for Go modules…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

of.needed: whether the environment has Go code that imports crossplane or crossplane-runtime as a module dependency

proposed.statement: The Go module path for Crossplane and Crossplane Runtime has changed from `github.com/crossplane/crossplane` and `github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime` to include a `v2` suffix: `github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2` and `github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2`; all import statements in code must be updated.
